clauses: Team members must reside in their primary location for at least 183 days (consecutive or not) within a calendar year. Team members may live or work outside their permanent location, as specified in Workday, for a maximum total of 183 days (approximately 6 months) per calendar year. GitLab is responsible for reporting and remitting taxes based on the location where a team member performs their work (i.e., earned income) and ensuring employment compliance based on each team member’s work location. This means that at least half of the time worked must be from the primary location. Please be aware that spending extended time in another country or state may have tax implications. Team members are encouraged to consult their personal tax advisor to understand the tax rules applicable in each location. If you believe you may exceed (or has already exceeded) the 183 days limit (or a lower threshold in certain countries), contact the People Operations Team immediately. Managers are responsible for ensuring that team members are abiding by the requirement to be in their primary location for the required amount of time and reporting when someone has or is about to exceed the limit.
note: 184 days away leave 182 days in Toronto.

Additionally, certain roles require team members to be present in the location for which they were hired to support business activities. Sales, for example, may require travel to customer sites and for the team member to be available for customers within a specific time zone. All Team members are required to obtain manager approval to work outside of their primary location regardless of the length of time at that location. Managers can deny a request or ask for a team member to change their request due to the impact on business results. A team member who fails to communicate and/or seek approval to work outside of their primary location could also result in underperformance management action or loss of employment, depending on the circumstances. Long-term relocations (greater than 183 days/6 months stay) must follow the application and approval process outlined below.
note: The annual constraints allow at most 183 days away; manager approval cannot waive them.
